elements.name: type
elements.brief: The platform the game runs on. The SDK can report platforms this module has no
elements.description:
The platform the game runs on. The SDK can report platforms this module has no
constant for, so compare against the constants rather than narrowing to them.

elements.name: has_integrated_auth
elements.brief: Whether the platform signs the player in itself.
elements.description: Whether the platform signs the player in itself.

elements.name: is_external_links_allowed
elements.brief: Whether the platform allows external links.
elements.description: Whether the platform allows external links.

elements.name: is_secret_code_auth_available
elements.brief: Whether sign-in by secret code is available.
elements.description: Whether sign-in by secret code is available.

elements.name: call_native_sdk
elements.brief: Calls a method of the platform's native SDK, or reads one of its objects or fields.
elements.description:
Calls a method of the platform's native SDK, or reads one of its objects or fields.
Raises when the method is not a non-empty string. An error comes back as
`{ error = "..." }`.

parameters.name: method
parameters.doc:
The dotted path to the method, object or field, for example
`"feedback.canReview"`. `var=path` saves the result in a JS variable, `var:method`
calls a method of a saved object.

parameters.name: parameters
parameters.doc:
The method's argument, or a list of its arguments. Functions cannot
be passed. Ignored when the path names an object or a field.

parameters.name: callback
parameters.doc: Receives the result when the method returns a promise.

returnvalues.doc: The result, or nothing when a callback is given.
